title: Evidences of Christianity

authorInfo.bio: William Paley (1743–1805) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Evidences of Christianity" by William Paley is a theological work written in the early 19th century. This treatise examines the historical and rational foundations of Christianity, arguing for its credibility through an analysis of the life and sufferings of its early followers, as well as the miraculous events attributed to its founder, Jesus Christ.
